title: Making a 3D character model
author: Cubey42
selftext: I've tried several attempts to try and get a good character model for my game but I've tried meshy, tripo, pixal 3d, and now hit em but the story is always the same, these results are just not very good and insanely expensive. I'm trying to find some method to get better topology but at this point I think just trying by hand in blender might be easier. I've seen some good results but for free options it seems pretty doomed, what to you all think?

comments.author: NativeFlowers4Eva
comments.body: Blender is pretty easy to learn. You’d get more out of just taking a course in it. You’ll have more consistent results as well.

comments.author: No-Spring1312
comments.body: Yeah AI 3D still feels rough for characters, I’d use it for blockouts and hand-clean topology in Blender.

comments.author: BillyMcDev
comments.body: Learning Blender is not something you're going to accomplish in one session, so having something specific to focus on and giving yourself plenty of practice sessions could eventually lead to the exact character model you are looking for. You're trading costs for time, but also getting more back from the time you spend than just a character model. By the time you reach your goal, you'll also have a wealth of experience in 3D modeling.

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body: I actually have some as it's not my first 3d program. I'm pretty happy with my low poly stuff but I really want a humanoid with some detail so I've been exploring how I could incorporate AI not to do all the work, but more like "set me up for success" I've been a tutorial learner my whole life so AI helps alot because questions I'd often have to Google now I can just ask it.

comments.author: RedditCensoredUs
comments.body: Try [https://github.com/YanWenKun/Hunyuan3D-2-WinPortable](https://github.com/YanWenKun/Hunyuan3D-2-WinPortable) .  You run it on your own machine so it costs $0.

comments.author: Nixy_oficial
comments.body: Blender es la mejor opción gratis, meshy y demas webs no sirven para eso, la Retopología  es un desastre, lo mejor es hacerlo sin IA y usar blender, al final te va a salir mejor si aprendes a usarlo
